# Smile Dental Clinic — LLMs Reference File
# https://dental-standard-v2.vercel.app

## About
Smile Dental Clinic is a full-service dental clinic located in Baner, Pune, Maharashtra, India.
Established in 2009, the clinic provides comprehensive dental care for adults and children under one roof.

## Doctor
- Name: Dr. Ananya Sharma
- Qualifications: BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics) — SPPU
- Specialisation: Full Mouth Rehabilitation, Cosmetic Veneers, Implant-Supported Dentures
- Experience: 15+ years

## Services
1. Cosmetic Dentistry — Teeth whitening, veneers, composite bonding, smile makeovers
2. Dental Implants — Titanium implants, full process in-house, 95%+ success rate
3. Full Mouth Rehabilitation — Comprehensive multi-treatment plans for complex cases
4. Root Canal Treatment — Modern anaesthesia, single or double sitting, pain-free
5. Crowns and Bridges — Ceramic and zirconia, completed in 2 visits
6. Orthodontic Treatment — Metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligners, all ages
7. Partial and Complete Dentures — Custom-fitted, implant-supported options available
8. Oral Prophylaxis — Professional scaling, polishing, gum health check, 30–45 min
9. Pediatric Dental Treatment — Child-friendly, fluoride, sealants, early orthodontic screening
